title: Trace European Blue Screw read sites
changes: Record source-site observations for six Blue Screw words; literal integration and indirect-source attribution remain open.
validation: Protected Wine unit m3aveg4f captures all six words across the retained 600-frame scene; three have matching original Thumb PC-relative LDR opcode/address witnesses and three share an indirect LDR scope. Wine drained.
limitations: Instruction scopes can include nested HLE/DMA reads; source extents, all callers, other scenes, Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified. No performance comparison was performed.
